coraza-waf.extensions.otoroshi.io.Coraza.description: A configuration of the coraza web application firewall (its wasm build), that the Coraza WAF plugin of a route applies through its `ref`: the seclang directives of the firewall, with or without the OWASP core rule set, in blocking or detection mode

_loc.description: The tenant (organization) and the teams the coraza configuration belongs to. The default tenant and team when absent

id.description: The unique id of the coraza configuration, the `ref` of the Coraza WAF plugins that use it

name.description: The display name of the coraza configuration, shown and searched in the list of the configurations of the backoffice

description.description: A free text describing the coraza configuration, shown and searched in the list of the configurations of the backoffice
description.example: Blocks the calls that break the OWASP core rule set

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the coraza configuration, with string values. The admin api stores the date of the last write of the entity under `created_at` or `updated_at`

tags.description: Free tags of the coraza configuration, to sort and search the configurations

inspect_in_body.description: Whether coraza inspects the bodies of the requests, true when absent

inspect_out_body.description: Whether coraza inspects the bodies of the responses, true when absent

is_blocking_mode.description: Whether coraza blocks the calls that break a rule (`SecRuleEngine On`) instead of only logging them (`SecRuleEngine DetectionOnly`), true when absent

include_owasp_crs.description: Whether the rules of the OWASP core rule set are loaded, true when absent

directives.description: The seclang directives (rules, actions, settings) applied on top of the recommended configuration of coraza, one per line. The lines that set the rule engine or the body access, or that include the bundled configurations, are ignored: the other fields set them. When absent, the `default` directives of the legacy `config.directives_map` field are read, none otherwise

pool_capacity.description: The number of coraza wasm vms of the pool of this configuration, that handle the calls concurrently. 2 when absent

example.name: Blocking WAF
example.description: Blocks the calls that break the OWASP core rule set
